text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - VSZ steelmaker sacked the directors of Investicna a Rozvojova Banka bank, overriding the objections of the National Bank of Slovakia.

- According to a public opinion survey by the AISA institute the most popular bank in Slovakia is the Vseobecna Uverova Banka bank with 56 percent of those polled saying it was their favourite, ahead of the savings bank Slovenska sporitelna, with 15 percent, which has been the mainstay of savings banks over the past 40 years.
- A parliamentary committee has begun debating a draft law on the protection of the domestic market against excessive imports.
PRAVDA - The ruling coalition is still split in the question of the privatisation of Slovakia's banks.

The ultra-left Workers' Party supports an opposition motion to postpone their privatisation indefinitely. The Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS), the senior colaition partner and the other junior partner, the Slovak National Party, are in favour of the speedy privatisation of financial institutions.
- Slovakia is seeking compensation from Germany for the victims of Nazism and has noted that in the recently signed Czech-German declaration Germany accepted responsibility for these victims.

NARODNA OBRODA - Pavol Kacic, a member of the HZDS and member of the presidium of the National Property Fund is convinced Slovak banks could be privatised this year and thet the Fund is prepared for such a move.

SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - Slovakia will probably have to privatise the banking sector during this year, as it has been forced to do it by the OECD and other western organisations, a ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS) official said.

- The Ministry of Agriculture will introduce a new subsidy policy, according to which the agricultural firms posting the losses in a long-term period will be excluded from the ministry's financial support program.
